notes.title: Voice Recognition Update
notes.content:
🎤 Update Time! 🧠✨

Hey everyone! Just pushed a new update that makes the game smoother, smarter, and a little easier on your machine. Here’s what’s new:

🔊 Voice Recognition Overhaul
Swapped out the old local voice model (it was kinda greedy with your CPU) for AWS Transcribe—a top-tier, real-time transcription system. It’s faster, way more accurate, and doesn’t hog your system resources. Win-win.

👄 New Lip Sync System
Out with the homebrew animation code, in with a slick new 3rd-party lip sync library. It looks way better and gives characters some extra life. You’ll see what I mean.

🖥️ Performance Boosts
Did some under-the-hood graphics optimization so things should run smoother, especially on lower-end PCs. Your toaster might just run it now. (No promises.)

🗑️ Simplified Voice Credit System
Since we're still a cozy little community, I removed the complex voice credit setup. Let’s keep it simple and focus on the fun.

Thanks for playing and being part of this wild little experiment. More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content: When you join a game for the first time you will be asked if you want a tutorial.  The tutorial will be created on the fly using AI.   If you want to reply the tutorial at any time you can go to the settings menu and choose "Reset to Default".  The tutorial does not cost any voice credits.

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This first patch allows you to play again simply by clicking a button or pressing any key instead of having to wait the 60 seconds or use the menu to reconnect.

Also if you had a name with a bunch of numbers or letters in it, we ignore those now so it won't sound so strange.

We also keep stats for each word that you solve and will show your personal best when you are repeating a word for the second time.

Since its actually quite difficult to get the devil out last we added an achievement for that.

Good luck everyone.
